There isn't actually a mobile page. It's an adaptive website which means it resizes to fit whatever screen size you're using. So on your tab you'll get the full layout whereas on a smaller mobile the sidebar is hidden behind a button.

When I made this post the mobile layout didn't have a sidebar at all but has come a long way since. I believe the only thing we're missing on the mobile layout is chat, but that might be browser specific.

Basically you have no choice in separate layouts because it's all adaptive. Took me a bit of getting used to and that has it's own set of pros and cons but I've grown to like it alot because the experience is exactly the same whether I'm using my phone or my PC.
